purpose: Remove heuristic authority from active TOPA research while preserving historical lineage and exploratory hypotheses as explicitly non-evidentiary objects.

requirements: no causal or semantic inflation beyond what the source establishes
checkable derivation or independently checkable counterexample
theorem-transfer identity or proved reduction/simulation when external results are used
frozen protocol before outcome inspection when feasible
versioned code and input data or exact acquisition procedure
reported measurement uncertainty and known instrument limits when applicable
effect size and uncertainty interval or exact test quantity
calibration or validation for probabilistic scores used as claims
no evidentiary weight from model preference or narrative coherence

forbidden_as_authority: confidence update without a defined statistical/Bayesian model
hard survivor or probable label used as evidence
observation ladder ordinal used as a quantitative weight
plausibility score without a calibrated reference class
visual pattern match without preregistered measurable criterion
finite benchmark extrapolated to asymptotic complexity
human intuition used as a proof premise

probability_allowed_only_if: a probability model is explicitly defined

allowed_promotion_objects: conditional theorem with all open premises named
finite executable replay labeled finite mechanics only
forbidden_promotions: empirical scaling fit to universal asymptotic theorem
provider CI PASS to mathematical truth
short proof existence to efficient proof search
polynomial work in derived state/cache/proof size to polynomial work in original input length
proof-system p-simulation to deterministic algorithmic simulation
big-O statement whose hidden constant or exponent depends on the input instance or growing family parameter

every_complexity_claim_must_name: the variable with respect to which polynomiality is claimed
whether exponent and constants are universal fixed constants independent of input/family
generation/search cost as distinct from verification cost
banned_shortcuts: K<=poly(N) assumed from width-bounded clause universe
polynomial recursion depth therefore polynomial tree size
finite observed scaling therefore fixed universal exponent
expected or high-probability construction therefore deterministic efficient construction without an algorithm/certificate

provenance_policy: Deprecated heuristic labels remain in historical records and may be quoted as historical states, but they cannot be upstream dependencies of a newly promoted active claim.
claim_ceiling: The strict science gate strengthens admissibility and accounting. It does not itself prove any scientific hypothesis, complexity bound, P=NP, P!=NP, or other world-level conclusion.
